fr_html: Le PRESIDENT proteste contre les amendements à l'article 1er. Il ne comprend pas pourquoi on s'élevait si fort contre des formules antérieurement admises sans difficulté.
en_html: The PRESIDENT protested against the amendments to Article 1. He did not understand why such strong objection was raised to a clause formerly admitted without difficulty.
